title: EF3 Tornado Strikes MCLB Albany
description: An EF3 tornado touched down on Marine Corps Logistics Base Albany carving a path of destruction in the warehouse district, damaging structures, military vehicles, downed power lines and leaving the landscape strewn with broken trees, Jan. 22.
keywords: MCLB Albany, tornado Marine Corps Logistics Base Albany, warehouse district military vehicles, Marine
